route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_hslice_dn/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_hslice_dn/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_hslice_dn --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_host_pc_slice_die  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: new kit route: same RTL as qkd_hslice es1, dn pin plan

reroute_reason.fix: pc1 native launch 241.7 > 220 on ctrl_es[0]: routed path (pc1 6_final, TT) flop QN -> BUFx3 fanout 20 -> INV -> BUFx10 wire buffer -> pin, 184 ps flop->pin, because opt_merge folded the launch_v copy into the pin flop; RTL ESPIN=1 dedicated ctrl_es pin register stage (+1 edge) (qkd_hslice_dn = the same module qkd_host_pc_slice_die with the S-facing pin plan; first route of this kit, on the es1 RTL)
